verification.precondition: A valid candidate session store grants one writer capability under its physical filesystem lock.
verification.stimulus: Attempt compare-and-commit with a mismatched four-field token, attempt to reuse the same writer, then access it after its lease closes.
verification.expectedSemanticState: The first attempt returns conflict, the second rejects as already used, the expired capability rejects, and the session bytes remain unchanged.
verification.expectedEvidenceState: The test runner reports the literal assertion: one Survey writer permits one compare-and-commit attempt and a stale token leaves the root unchanged
verification.forbiddenMutation: A conflict must not validate or publish its proposed post-image, a capability must not attempt CAS twice, and a writer must not outlive its lock lease.

behavior: one Survey writer permits one compare-and-commit attempt and a stale token leaves the root unchanged
